lead: Vinod Khanna was an Indian film actor, born on 6 October 1946 in Peshawar.
He died on 27 April 2017 in Mumbai at the age of 70.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of Member of the 16th Lok Sabha and Member of the 12th Lok Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of Vinod Khanna: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.
